info.name: Civicon — Auth, Issues, Media & Lifecycle
info.description:
Auth, identity and civic issue reporting for the Civicon backend.

Start the API with `npm run start:dev` and seed it with `npm run seed` — every seeded account uses the password in {{demo_password}}.

Folders run top to bottom: later requests reuse tokens and ids that earlier ones set.

variable.description: Shared by every account created by `npm run seed`.
Set automatically by any sign-in request.
Used to prove the 401 messages are identical.
Set by 'Sign in as a second citizen'.
Set by 'Attach a photo' or the media listing.
Set by 'Sign in as the volunteer'.
Set by 'Sign in as the reporter'.
Set by 'Find an open issue the reporter owns'.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Sign-up and sign-in. Both register and login return { token, user }; the token's claims carry the user's roles, so guards need no database round-trip.

Login and register write `token` and `user_id` into the collection variables, so every later request is authenticated automatically.

request.description:
Registration always creates a CITIZEN. There is no `roles` field to send — volunteering is an action a citizen takes, not a role they hold, and AGENCY / SPONSOR / ADMIN come from the seed or an admin grant.

The email carries a random suffix so the collection can be re-run: the seed already owns the fixed addresses, and a duplicate returns 409.

item.name: Users (admin only)
item.description:
User administration, restricted to ADMIN. There is no POST /users — registration is the only account-creation path, since a second one would produce users with no password.

This folder is self-contained: it signs in as the seeded admin, creates a disposable user to operate on, and deletes it at the end. Safe to run end-to-end.

item.name: Hazard
item.description:
The three-step classification gate: an observation the reporter ticks, the classification call, and the human decision that clears or restricts an issue. Run `npm run seed -- --fresh` first.

UNRESTRICTED is the only claimable hazard level. This folder reports an issue with an observation ticked, which restricts it with no AI call, proves a volunteer is refused, then has an agency clear it and the same volunteer claim it.

request.description: The seeded citizen reports the issue this folder classifies.
A different citizen, who will try to claim it.
The seeded agency, who will make the human decision.

item.name: Report an issue with an observation ticked

request.description: Ticking an observation at report time is what restricts the issue outright once classified — no AI call needed. Creating it does not classify it: `hazard` starts UNCLASSIFIED regardless of what was ticked.
The reporter submits the report for classification. The ticked observation decides it deterministically — this call never reaches the AI when one was ticked.

exec: pm.test('the reporter is the source, not the AI', () => pm.expect(json.hazardAssessment.source).to.eql('REPORTER'));

request.description: UNRESTRICTED is the only claimable level. This one needs an agency.
